title: Zoom in: what a pod does with a read for a hot key
caption: Local copy first, one shared refill per pod, and the refill reads one of several copies of the key.

steps.text: The key is on the hot list.
The local copy has just passed its 1 s lifetime, and no refill is running.
Read one of 8 copies of the key (item:777#0..7, spread over shards), chosen at random, so even refills don't all hit one shard.
Keep it in pod memory for 1 s and return.

scenarios.name: Burst of misses
scenarios.summary: Hundreds of requests on one pod find the copy expired in the same millisecond: request coalescing sends one refill.

steps.text: The first request finds no refill running and starts one.
Every other request sees the refill in flight and waits on it instead of calling the shard.
When the refill returns, all waiters get the same value.

scenarios.name: Copy unavailable
scenarios.summary: The shard holding copy #3 is down. A copy is just a replica of the value, so try another one.

steps.text: The GET for item:777#3 times out after 20 ms.
Retry once with a different copy number on a different shard.
If every copy fails, return the expired local value for up to a few seconds: slightly stale beats an error during a sale.

scenarios.name: Not hot yet
scenarios.summary: A key that just went viral isn't on the list: every read takes the normal path until detection catches up.

steps.text: item:512 is not on the hot list.
Its single shard takes every read. Shorten the detection window or let each pod protect itself with a small local top-K.
